title: Console grooming: Apr sprint triage & cutlist
content:
Goal: fast triage to produce a conservative sprint scope for April sprint (2-week) with a prioritized cut list and quick wireframe notes for the top 3 stories. Keep hosted-console stability and rollout tooling changes separate from new UX experiments.

Context / constraints:
- Team stable headcount for sprint: 3 FE, 2 BE, 1 designer (shared) + SRE on-call.
- Priority: keep SLO (95p latency) regressions below 5% risk; any infra-facing work must be scheduled with SRE.
- Cut aggressively: features without clear acceptance criteria or >8 story points should be postponed.

Sprint goals (proposal):
1) Shipping: Model route health page (critical visibility) - P0
2) Ops: Rollout canary toggles + telemetry (safety + rollback) - P0
3) QoL: Token-level cost breakdown (view-only, MVP) - P1
4) Experiment: Compact embeddings explorer (design prototype) - P2 (spike)

Triage table (summary of tickets reviewed 2026-03-09):
- RINF-3482: "Model route health page" — summary: aggregated per-route latency, error-rate, last-failed-reason. Est: 8 SP. Blockers: needs new metrics from infra (MET-77). Decision: keep as P0 but split into 2 stories: backend metrics API (5 SP, infra dependency) + frontend dashboard (3 SP). Owner: Liam.
- RINF-3510: "Canary rollout toggles + telemetry" — summary: add per-deployment canary percent controls and automatic fallback. Est: 13 SP. Blockers: design review pending, SRE review needed. Decision: cut to MVP for sprint: server-side toggle + simple telemetry + manual rollback (8 SP). Defer auto-fallback to later. Owner: Diego.
- RINF-3526: "Token cost breakdown view" — summary: show token counts and cost per-route for last 7 days. Est: 5 SP. Decision: include as P1; frontend-only with existing usage API. Owner: Claire.
- RINF-3548: "Embeddings explorer (compact)" — summary: prototype for browsing embedding vectors. Est: 8 SP. Decision: convert to 3-day spike (2 SP) to validate UX & infra cost. If spike ok, backlog for next sprint. Owner: Maya.
- RINF-3499: "Route-level RBAC controls" — summary: fine-grained route permissions. Est: 8-13 SP, security review required. Decision: cut (postpone) — too risky for current sprint.
- RINF-3504: "Streaming response UX polish" — summary: handle partial responses for function-calling flows. Est: 3 SP. Decision: low-risk, include as stretch if time permits. Owner: Priya.

Cut list (items explicitly removed from this sprint):
- Route-level RBAC (RINF-3499) — defer to security sprint Q2.
- Auto-fallback rollout automation (part of RINF-3510) — defer until telemetry baseline collected.
- Full embeddings explorer with nearest-neighbor indexing — defer until spike outcome.
- Deep prompt history redesign (RINF-3340) — postponed; needs UX research.

Acceptance criteria (for P0 items):
- Model route health page:
  - Backend exposes /api/v1/console/route-metrics?range=7d returning latency_p95, error_rate, last_failure_reason per route.
  - Frontend displays sortable table and sparkline per metric, with link to route details.
  - Automated test coverage: unit + 1 e2e smoke test.
- Canary toggles MVP:
  - Console allows setting canary percent for a deployment and stores config in rollout service.
  - Telemetry emitted to existing metrics (rollout.percent, rollout.manual_rollback).
  - Manual rollback button triggers rollout-service rollback API.

Wireframe notes (quick sketches / text):
1) Route health page (desktop):
  - Top: filter by model family + search box (left). Time range selector (right).
  - Middle: table columns: route name | p95 ms | error % | traffic % | last failure (tooltip) | actions (drill).
  - Row expand: small sparkline + recent logs snippet + link to open support ticket modal.
  - UX detail: color-coding thresholds (green/yellow/red) tied to SLO config.
2) Canary modal (small):
  - Slider for percent (0-100) with quick presets: 1%, 5%, 25%, 100%.
  - Confirmation banner shows expected traffic path and telemetry events that will be emitted.
  - Accessibility: slider keyboard + input box.
3) Token breakdown (compact card on route page):
  - Mini donut + table listing tokens by role (prompt, completion) and cost estimate for period.
  - CTA: "Download CSV" for billing export.

Dependencies and risks:
- MET-77 (infra metrics pipeline): blocker for full route health; coordinate with infra and SRE.
- SRE availability: canary safety checks require on-call review; schedule pairing session.
- Billing schema changes: token cost needs mapping from billing service; confirm field names with finance (ticket FIN-98).

Estimates summary (post-split):
- Backend metrics API (RINF-3482a): 5 SP (Liam)
- Frontend route health dashboard (RINF-3482b): 3 SP (Claire)
- Canary toggles MVP (RINF-3510-MVP): 8 SP (Diego + BE)
- Token breakdown card (RINF-3526): 5 SP (Claire)
- Embeddings explorer spike (RINF-3548-spike): 2 SP (Maya)
- Streaming UX polish (RINF-3504): 3 SP (Priya)
- Contingency / buffer: 3 SP
Total committed: 29 SP (within team's typical 30 SP capacity)

Rollout plan / monitoring:
- Feature flags for route health (server flag) to control visibility to internal beta.
- Canary toggles telemetry sent to dashboard channel #console-rollouts; SRE subscribes to alerts for rollback triggers.
- Post-deploy checklist: smoke e2e, manual spot-check of 5 high-traffic routes, verify telemetry events.

Open questions (to resolve before finalizing sprint board):
- MET-77 ETA from infra? (action: Liam to ping infra by 2026-03-11)
- Do we need a separate RBAC backlog item tied to enterprise contract review? (action: Priya to ask Sales: Jamie Ruiz)
- Billing field mapping: who owns FIN-98 mapping? (action: Claire to loop finance by 2026-03-12)

Action items with owners and due dates:
- Split RINF-3482 into backend/frontend tickets (Liam) — due 2026-03-11
- Trim RINF-3510 to MVP and update ticket with rollback API details (Diego) — due 2026-03-11
- Prepare designs for route health table + color thresholds (Maya) — due 2026-03-12
- Create smoke e2e plan and add to CI (Priya + SRE) — due 2026-03-13
- Create JIRA subtask RINF-3526-CSV-export (Claire) — due 2026-03-11

Notes to reviewer: please comment inline on priorities if any of the P1 items should be promoted — I tried to be conservative. If infra says MET-77 will slip, recommend we push health to next sprint and use capacity for RBAC prep work.

Quick meeting cadence: 30-min grooming follow-up Wednesday 2026-03-11 10:00 PST to finalize board; invite queue: product-console, eng-serving-runtime lead, SRE lead, designer.

End of doc.
